(1) **Crop A:** Yes, there is a title **"Benvenuto!"**. There is **no subtitle line visible** below it in this crop; the area below the title is empty black space. The text is fully visible, complete, and there is no text overlap.

(2) **Crop B:** The area below the two action buttons shows the **top edges of two empty-looking rounded rectangles** (likely the stat cards), but they are heavily **cut off at the bottom of the image**, so their content (numbers for XP, Racha, Monete, Tarjetas) is **not visible/readable**. There is **no install-app button** visible in this crop. A bottom tab bar is partially visible at the very bottom edge.

(3) **Rendering Defects:** 
*   **Cut-off text/elements:** In Crop B, the text at the very top ("certificados...") is cut off at the top edge. More significantly, the stat cards and the bottom navigation tab bar are severely cut off at the bottom edge, making them incomplete.
*   **Empty boxes:** The visible portions of the stat cards appear as empty dark boxes with just their top borders showing.
*   No overlapping text or broken images are observed.
